title: Baltic states reaffirm support for Ukraine on historic day in Tallinn
summary_full: Today, on the 35th anniversary of the restoration of Estonia’s independence, President of the Riigikogu (parliament) of Estonia Lauri Hussar, Speaker of the Saeima of Latvia Daiga Mieriņa and Speaker of the Seimas of Lithuania Juozas Olekas issued a Joint Statement in Tallinn, in which they reaffirm their strong support for Ukraine and emphasise the need for active cooperation in pursuing initiatives to strengthen the eastern border, counter disinformation campaigns, and address migratory pressure.
